# WoW AndroWhere 0.8.6

- **HD pack patches explained.** With the WotLK HD client, each patch in **Addons** → **Client** now says what it changes, and the switches follow the pack's own rules. Turning on undead without bones also turns on HD characters, dungeon minimaps turn on dungeon maps, and turning off the one a patch needs turns that patch off too. Only one of the two character creation styles can be on at a time.

## Install

Download **WoW-AndroWhere.apk** below, or update from inside the app. It installs over 0.8.5 and keeps your settings, saved login, game files and addons.

If Android says the app "conflicts with an existing package", your current copy came from somewhere else, such as the upstream WoW Foreverywhere releases. Uninstall it first, then install this one. Your game files and addons stay on your storage.

New to the app? See the [README](https://github.com/danielnoam/WoWAndroWhere#getting-started) for setup.
